item.title: CVE-2026-126190 · Soup Sieve: Polynomial-time denial of service in the descendant combinator
item.description: ## Summary Matching a selector that uses the descendant combinator (`a b`) takes time that grows polynomially with how deeply the document is nested, and each extra descendant combinator in the selector raises the degree by one. A selector with `k` descendant combinators takes `O(n^(k+1))` time on a chain of `n` nested elements. item.title: CVE-2026-126192 · Soup Sieve: General sibling combinator inside :has() matches untrusted HTML in quadratic time
item.description: ## Summary Matching a selector that puts a general-sibling combinator inside `:has()`, such as `div:has(a ~ b)`, against untrusted HTML runs in O(n²) time in the number of sibling elements. item.title: CVE-2026-126367 · @grpc/grpc-js: safe_regex incorrectly applies partial string matching for patterns with alternation
item.description: ### Summary The StringMatcher/PathMatcher for `safe_regex` builds its RE2 as `^${regex}$` with no surrounding group.
